title: Platform cost object settings
description: Portal-owned manual cost objects and explicit availability/label overrides of exact typed imported keys. No SAP fields or import provenance are copied or edited. See decision 0025.

_id.description: SHA-256 of UTF-8 type:number, exact case-sensitive key, immutable.

number.description: Exact immutable costCenterNumber or wbsNumber; leading zeros and punctuation retained.

origin.description: Manual entry or platform settings referencing an imported key. If a reference disappears it is unavailable, never converted to manual.

label.description: Platform description. Import text remains unchanged.

active.description: Explicit platform availability approval. Overrides imported eligibility, without changing or claiming SAP lifecycle/validation.

plantIds.description: Plants approved for new assignments; an active entry needs at least one active plant.

history.description: Atomic append-only revisions with actor ID, time, version, label, active, plantIds and reason. Never removed or truncated by the editor.

mode.description: Follow current/future imports, or use explicit platform label/availability/plants. Manual entries require override. Inherit stores empty label/plants and active=false; effective values come directly from the current import.
